headline: A 2012 executive order brought back a federal advisory commission, but the title alone does not say which one.
what_it_does: This order from President Obama reestablished an advisory commission, meaning it restarted a group that gives advice to the federal government. The title does not name the commission or describe its topic, members, or duties. Advisory commissions usually make recommendations and do not have power to set rules on their own.
when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, December 21, 2012, though the source material does not state this.
